case_title: BANK OF THE WEST VS. LAMBROS PAPPAS et al

docket_entries.description: COMMON COUNTS/OPEN BOOK ACCOUNT/COLLECTIONS, COMPLAINT FILED BY PLAINTIFF BANK OF THE WEST AS TO DEFENDANT PAPPAS, LAMBROS AKA LAMBROS PAPANASTASIS INDIVIDUALLY AND DBA SUNSET CLEANERS & TAILORS DOES ONE THROUGH TEN INCLUSIVE SUMMONS ISSUED, JUDICIAL COUNCIL CIVIL CASE COVER SHEET FILED CASE MANAGEMENT CONFERENCE SCHEDULED FOR JUL-11-2008 PROOF OF SERVICE DUE ON                  SEP-08-2008 CASE MANAGEMENT STATEMENT DUE ON         JUN-26-2008

CAUSE CALLED, THE COURT ORDERED THAT PLAINTIFF BANK OF THE WEST HAVE AND RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT PAPPAS, LAMBROS AKA LAMBROS PAPANASTASIS INDIVIDUALLY AND DBA SUNSET CLEANERS & TAILORS POSSESSION OF THE FOLLOWING DESCRIBED PROPERTY, TO WIT: ONE FULTON 6HP GAS FIRED BOILER FAIR MARKET VALUE $2,500.00, OR IN CASE A DELIVERY OF SAID PROPERTY TO PLAINTIFF CANNOT BE HAD, THEN THAT THE PLAINTIFF HAVE AND RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT $5,903.23 DAMAGES, $925.00 ATTORNEY FEES, $310.00 COSTS, $142.56 INTEREST, TOTAL JUDGMENT $7,280.79, SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT
PRE-TRIAL CALENDAR SWEEP, CASE MANAGEMENT CONFERENCE CALENDAR OF JUL-11-2008, OFF CALENDAR, DISMISSAL OR JUDGMENT ON FILE AS TO ALL DEFENDANTS
